items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Even John Hammond came down, who was then responsible for the Basie band, I understand...

ctx.x: singers or something, we would write things with the tenor saxophone, the alto and the trumpet, and maybe have a bass (?) or a fourth part to be like a horn, and we'd stretch the harmonies out. It was a very nice little band. And people came down there...

Even John Hammond came down, who was then responsible for the Basie band, I understand... The thing that John Hammond didn't like about our band was that we didn't play enough Blues, you know. And at that particular time, we were experimenting with all kinds of chords and harmonies, and we weren't that much into the Blues as we should have been. We didn't realize just what Blues really meant. We played some Blues and stuff like that, but we were more or less into experimenting and arranging things more intricate…
